one_liner: Collaborative work management and spreadsheet-style project planning for teams.
access_notes: API access and Developer Tools (for OAuth app registration) require a licensed Smartsheet user on the Business plan or higher.
blocker_notes: Plan gating (Business+ license needed) and Developer Tools registration required for OAuth apps.

evidence.quote: Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management.
The email address used to register for Developer Tools must belong to an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher.
The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys)… Each API request requires passing in an access token as the Bearer value in your authorization header…
If your scenario involves user consent and interaction, it’s typically best to use OAuth… a 3‑legged process.
Smartsheet webhooks… configure your applications to receive real-time notifications when specific Smartsheet events occur.
Interact with your project data… using the Smartsheet MCP server connected to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients.

_trail.quote: "Interact with your project data in Smartsheet using the Smartsheet MCP server connected to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients."
